checkpointPayload.description: From the ui-ux-pro-max review (2026-10-30), item 4: the bottom tab bar has six tabs (Dashboard, Scores, Songs, Sessions, Arcade, Settings). The skill's priority table says at most five bottom nav items. Its guideline search returned no specific match, so this comes from the built-in rule. Suggested fix: move Settings to a header icon on Dashboard (stack route) and keep five tabs. Needs the user's call on which tab to move.
checkpointPayload.title: Mobile: reduce bottom tabs from 6 to 5
